verdict.rationale: Kushki is a payment processor, so payout reconciliation is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack covers charge acceptance, captures, refunds, 3DS and tokens, but none of it documents an API for settlement or payout records, balance transactions, or mapping bank deposits to underlying charges. The supplier-payment page (kushki-docs-18) describes outbound disbursements to suppliers, employees and partners, which is a different capability from settlement reconciliation, so it earns no credit here.
